**Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland** is a regional healthcare cluster operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark [^src3], [^src6]. It is one of the local organizational units evaluated in the national clinical quality development program (RKKP) for the treatment of [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation). The cluster's performance is tracked across multiple clinical quality indicators to monitor and improve cardiovascular care and stroke prevention at the local level.

In terms of clinical outcomes and adherence to national guidelines, Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland has demonstrated strong performance in specific areas. Notably, it is one of the health clusters that successfully meets the national standard for Indikator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation treatment for newly diagnosed patients, achieving a result of 92.6% [^src1]. However, performance varies across different metrics. For [[indikator-3|Indikator 3]], the cluster's goal achievement rate was recorded at 52.9%, highlighting a significant variation when compared to top-performing units like [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]] at 87.9% [^src9]. 

The cluster is also making progress in patient education. While it has not yet fully met the national standard for [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] (which tracks the proportion of newly diagnosed patients receiving structured patient education within the first year), its result of 42.5% places it quite close to fulfilling the standard [^src5]. Additionally, the cluster is included in national geographic mappings and supplementary analyses, such as the incidence of ischemic stroke ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) among atrial fibrillation patients, which helps identify regional variations in clinical practice and patient outcomes across Denmark [^src4]. Other tracked metrics for the cluster include 1-year and 2-year treatment coverage [^src2], annual P-creatinine measurements [^src4], and the incidence of severe bleeding and heart failure within the first year of diagnosis [^src7], [^src8].
